plan.title: Capability Integration — no derelict capabilities (MVP)
plan.goal: Every implementation/tool/feature integrated into agents' working memory, workflows and repertoire; none derelict, unused, stale, dead or unavailable (enabled != done).
success_criteria: aq-capability-audit UNDISCOVERABLE, STALE-CLAIM, DEAD-CANDIDATE trend to 0
every remaining capability is wired into a workflow or archived (Rule 12)

phases.name: flagship gaps
phases.goal: vector DB + understand-anything + dormant modules real

items.name: restore aq-* usage logging
items.goal: aq-usage.jsonl records every aq-* invocation again; audit uses logged use, not inference
items.validation_goal: last-30d aq-usage.jsonl non-empty after a day of normal use; audit 'used' for aq-* from usage log
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

acceptance.note: Preauthorized by owner; evidence: PR #442 (commit 8a955e16) restored aq-usage-hook into 185 aq-* scripts writing to local usage ledger

items.name: capability audit tool + baseline
items.goal: deterministic aq-capability-audit with 6 classes and a committed baseline
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

acceptance.note: Preauthorized by owner; evidence: PR #440 (commit ce4d3309) committed deterministic aq-capability-audit tool and baseline report

items.name: audit on timer + RSI regression feed
items.goal: the audit runs periodically; worsening class transitions become RSI incidents
items.validation_goal: timer active; a synthetic regression is recorded by aq-rsi sweep
items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's. Observability (2026-10-10): dashboard /prsi/actions capability_audit row + QA rsi.3 (report freshness) / rsi.4 (timer active), ported from Codex's parallel ci-3 onto #446's design. MVP: enabled-for-testing, not done.

acceptance.note: Preauthorized by owner; evidence: PR #446 (commit 117d321a) and PR #452 (commit 33e7a1d6) landed capability audit timer, RSI regression adapter, dashboard action row and QA rsi.3/rsi.4 checks

items.editorial_note: MVP: enabled-for-testing is not done; acceptance is the owner's.

acceptance.note: Preauthorized by owner; evidence: PR #442 (commit 8a955e16) and PR #468 (commit c018aa4a) generated agent-loaded capability index, reducing UNDISCOVERABLE count to 0 in live audit
